method: Lanczos resample of the accepted fit: armalegs: its recipe's registration box [0,4,1368,1210] is in factor-6 pixels and has no whole-pixel factor-4 equivalent, so re-fitting would change the accepted registration (changing only the factor misplaces the source and leaves a UV component uncovered); the scorpion source image is untracked and no longer on disk. Heights re-authored from the 4x diffuse by update_enemy_heights.height_for (which reproduced the committed heights first). armabody and grem were re-fitted at factor 4 through their recipes instead.
